appearance_facts.fact: The chart title is 'Year vs. Number of doctors per 1,000 inhabitants'.
The chart displays a single blue line with circular markers, connecting data points from the year 2000 to 2017.5.
The y-axis is inverted: higher values are at the bottom (2.5) and lower values are at the top (0.0).
The line trends downward from left to right, indicating a decrease in the number of doctors per 1,000 inhabitants over time.
The final data point (at 2017.5) is the lowest on the chart, located near the bottom of the y-axis, at approximately 2.5.
The first data point (at 2000) is the highest on the chart, located near the top of the y-axis, at approximately 1.7.

public_definitions: The task is to review the trend in physicians per 1,000 residents over the reporting period (2000-2017.5) and select the most appropriate follow-up pathway based on the end-of-period capacity pattern.

The three available follow-up pathways are: 'Route to the physician capacity expansion review pathway', 'Route to the physician shortage response review pathway', and 'Route to the general health system statistics page'.
The 'Routing note' field is optional and can be used to provide additional context.

The 'visible_context_1', 'visible_context_2', and 'visible_context_3' fields are read-only and provide context: 'Program area' = 'Health workforce planning', 'Monitoring focus' = 'Physician capacity relative to population', 'Routing workflow' = 'Dashboard-based follow-up assignment'.
uncertain: The exact numerical values of the data points are not visible, only their relative positions on the inverted y-axis.
